subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: After the concrete sidebar session/dashboard repairs land, should iPhone permanently replace the tab-bar and Control-hub navigation model with this sidebar-only shell?
rationale: The PR intentionally removes a public root-navigation workflow across iPhone layouts; code review can validate behavior but cannot decide the permanent product direction.

options.title: Adopt the sidebar shell
options.body: Land the redesign after the session-state fixes and preserve the documented launch aliases as the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Keep tabs on phones
options.body: Retain the existing phone tab workflow and narrow this work to additive session or dashboard improvements.

options.title: Stage the redesign
options.body: Land shared sidebar data/components first, then introduce the phone shell behind an explicitly approved rollout decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt the sidebar shell
recommendation.body: Land the redesign after the session-state fixes and preserve the documented launch aliases as the compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR and the related Overview-retirement proposal indicate direct involvement in the intended navigation convergence.
